email.signup.subject: Confirm your email address
email.signup.body: Someone, perhaps you, asked to create an account for {client} with this address. To go on, enter this code or follow the link below. They expire in {minutes} minutes and work only in the browser where you started.
email.signup.footer: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: no account is created without the code.

email.signup_exists.body: Someone, perhaps you, tried to create an account for {client} with this address, which has one already. To go on, sign in with your password; if you forgot it, choose "Forgot your password?" on the sign-in page.

email.reset.footer: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password has not changed.
